richiami.difetto: Under certain collision conditions, the seat may experience unintended movement after impact, which could increase the risk of occupant injury. The product does not comply with the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of motor vehicles and their trailers, and of systems, components and separate technical units intended for such vehicles.
richiami.rimedio: Type of economic operator to whom the measure(s) were ordered: Other · Category of measure(s): Recall of the product from end users · Date of entry into force: 17/11/2025
richiami.titolo: Under certain collision conditions, the seat may experience unintended movement after impact, which could increase the risk of occupant injury.

richiami.difetto: On affected vehicles there is the possibility for the front seat to delatch in a front collision.
richiami.rimedio: An attachment will be fitted to the seat rail to prevent delatching occurring.
richiami.titolo: Possibility for front seat to delatch in a front collision.

richiami.difetto: EMISSIONS DO NOT MEET REGULATORY REQUIREMENTS
richiami.rimedio: A revised calibration will be provided to correct the NOx emissions to ensure they fall within legal limits.
richiami.titolo: EMISSIONS DO NOT MEET REGULATORY REQUIREMENTS

richiami.difetto: On affected vehicles the position of the PTC Ground Wire may not be correctly anchored to the vehicle Body. This can potentially result in insulation being trapped between the wire and the body creating a poor connection and a risk of over-heating.
richiami.rimedio: Check the insulation and modifying if necessary.
richiami.titolo: On affected vehicles the position of the PTC Ground Wire may not be correctly anchored to the vehicle Body. This can potentially result in insulation being trapped between the wire and the body creating a poor connection and a risk of over-heating.

richiami.difetto: On affected vehicles there is potential for MG4 vehicles to superlock whilst still in running mode when the vehicle comes to a stop.  The doors are locked and cannot be opened by the interior/exterior handles the remote key is disabled and the windows will not function.
richiami.rimedio: The remedy involves a software update.
richiami.titolo: Potential for MG4 vehicles to superlock whilst still in running mode

richiami.difetto: Brake lights are not activated when the car is regeneratively braking over 1.3m/s2.
richiami.rimedio: A software reflash of the vehicle Gateway Module to ensure that the brake lights are activated according to the regulation.
richiami.titolo: BRAKE LIGHTS ARE NOT ACTIVATED WHEN THE CAR IS REGENERATIVELY BRAKING OVER 1.3m/s2

richiami.difetto: Fuel tank strap bolts were not manufactured to the correct hardness specification.
richiami.rimedio: Fit replacement bolt fixing and torque to the specified load.
richiami.titolo: FUEL TANK STRAP BOLTS WERE NOT MANUFACTURED TO THE CORRECT HARDNESS SPECIFICATION

richiami.difetto: Vehicle roof bars were previously recorded as being non-load bearing.
richiami.rimedio: Confirmation of vehicle roof being capable of carrying 35kg to be sent to dealers and customers
richiami.titolo: VEHICLE ROOF BARS WERE PREVIOUSLY RECORDED AS BEING NON-LOAD BEARING

richiami.difetto: A brake pipe in the engine compartment may have been incorrectly positioned and could foul the engine. In extreme cases the pipe may fail and allow brake fluid to leak.
richiami.rimedio: On affected vehicles check position and condition of brake pipe. Reposition or replace pipe as necessary.
richiami.titolo: REDUCTION IN BRAKING PERFORMANCE

richiami.difetto: null The brake pipe could foul the engine during normal operation of the vehicle. Leakage of brake fluid may occur resulting in reduction of braking performance.
richiami.rimedio: Type of economic operator taking notified measure(s): Manufacturer · Category of measure(s): Recall of the product from end users · Date of entry into force: Unknown
richiami.titolo: null The brake pipe could foul the engine during normal operation of the vehicle.

richiami.difetto: On certain right hand drive vehicles it has been identified that the main vehicle wiring harness could become damaged during installation. This could lead to a short circuit and electrical malfunctions.
richiami.rimedio: Recall all affected vehicles to check and if required repair and secure the main wiring harness.
richiami.titolo: SHORT CIRCUIT MAY OCCUR

richiami.difetto: Under extreme conditions it is possible that the rear suspension top arm may fail.
richiami.rimedio: Recall all affected vehicles and replace the nearside and offside rear suspension top arms.
richiami.titolo: REAR SUSPENSION MAY FAIL

richiami.difetto: In an isolated number of cases it is possible that the lower suspension swivel/ball joint mounting rivets can become detached. This may in extreme cases if not identified result in a possible detachment of the joint.
richiami.rimedio: Recall all affected vehicles to relace the lower suspension arm and swivel/ball joint.
richiami.titolo: SUSPENSION MAY FAIL

richiami.difetto: Poor weld penetration between the front suspension shock absorber damper and the lower fixing eye may cause detach of fixing eye.  In extreme circumstances detachment may cause loss of directional control of the vehicle.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the affected vehicles to have the defective units replaced with quality assured units.
richiami.titolo: POSSIBLE LOSS OF DIRECTIONAL CONTROL.

richiami.difetto: Wheel trim can contact and damage tyre outer wall.
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles replace wheel trims with modified type and replace any tyre which has been damaged by the trim if that damage meets MOT test fail requirements. This is being administered by VOSA.
richiami.titolo: WHEEL TRIM CAN RUB ON THE TYRE SIDEWALL

richiami.difetto: There is a possibility that the if a front road spring failed at the lower end it could contact and damage the tyre
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles and fit an additional lower road spring retention fixture which will protect the tyre in the event of a spring failure
richiami.titolo: POSSIBLE DAMAGE AND DEFLATION OF TYRE DUE TO ROAD SPRING

richiami.difetto: The air pipes to the brake chambers may rub against the lower edge of the suspension hanger as the axles move up and down. An air leak may occur.
richiami.modello: MERITOR DISC BRAKES , MERITOR DISC BRAKES
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected trailers to re-locate air pipes and to fit a protective sleeve to the air pipes.
richiami.titolo: BRAKE AIR PIPES MAY CHAFE
